title: Oh Mary casting Maya Rudolph — includes show opinions
transcript: There is currently a menace wreaking havoc in the Broadway community. And I am, of course, talking about the Oh Mary casting team, who just announced that Maya Rudolph will be taking over the role of Mary Todd Lincoln. Now, you're probably thinking, Ben, that sounds like really great casting. What is the big deal? And that's exactly the problem. You see, this is yet another can't miss casting choice in a string of can't miss casting choices. And we can't keep letting them get away with this. We have let them cast Titus Burgess, Jane Krakowski, Jinkx Monsoon, John Cameron Mitchell. And I'm just asking, when will enough be enough? Our wallets and our bank accounts simply cannot handle it. So I am begging you all to please exercise extreme caution. Casting of this magnitude has been known to lead to impulse purchases. I should know, because I'm ashamed to admit they got me. I was just minding my own business this morning when all of a sudden, I see this casting announcement and just completely black out. And when I came back to it, I had a ticket order confirmation in my email. It really is that fast. And I will share. I am not someone who normally see shows multiple times, and yet I now have tickets to see Oh Mary for the fifth time. So if it can happen to me, it can happen to you. Stay safe out there, everyone.
